windowsBinarySources.notes: The official PostGIS 3.7.0 Windows page now advertises pgRouting 4.0.2, while the previously audited immutable PG18 bundle SQL runtime reported pgRouting 4.0.1 (the DLL basename libpgrouting-4.0.dll is not a precise version). Do not attribute 4.0.2 to that exact ZIP or infer source/build provenance, rights/NOTICE closure or pgextwin public GET authority.
